shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "for f in AGENTS.md package.json tsconfig.json next.config.ts pages/*.js pages/blog/*.js pages/api/posts/*.js components/* styles/*; do printf '\\n### %s\\n' \""'$f"; cat "$f"; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'find __agent_eval__ -maxdepth 2 -type f -print && git diff -- package.json && node -v && npm -v'

/bin/bash -lc "find pages -maxdepth 4 -print && git status --short && rg -n 'next/router|next/head|next/document|getStaticProps|getServerSideProps|getStaticPaths|NextApi|pages/' app components lib styles || true"
/bin/bash -lc 'rmdir pages/api/posts pages/api pages/blog pages && npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git status --short && test ! -e pages && echo '"'pages directory absent' && rg -n 'next/router|next/head|next/document|getStaticProps|getServerSideProps|getStaticPaths|NextApiRequest|NextApiResponse' --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' --glob '"'!.next/**'"' --glob '"'!package-lock.json'"' . || true"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat tsconfig.json && curl -sS -o /dev/null -D - -X PATCH http://127.0.0.1:3100/api/posts | head -20 && curl -sS -o /dev/null -D - -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3100/api/posts/42 | head -20'
/bin/bash -lc "cat .gitignore && cat next-env.d.ts && rg -n '<title>|404 - Page Not Found' <(curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:3100/missing-route) | head -3"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && test ! -e pages && git status --short && rg --files app components lib | sort'
